verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The MCP 'limits you set' and the AI Helpbot transparency overview concern agent permissions and AI disclosure, not telemetry controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
